name: Sesame Balls
description: Chewy fried glutinous rice spheres coated in sesame seeds and filled with lotus paste or red bean—a dim sum classic.
ingredients: a handful of fresh cilantro, chopped
a generous spoonful of soy sauce
instructions: Preheat your oven (or set up your steamer or frying station) and lightly grease your pan or molds with toasted sesame oil.
In a large bowl, whisk together the egg noodles and chili oil until evenly combined.
In a separate bowl, blend the toasted sesame seeds with the pork stock until smooth and well incorporated.
Gently fold the wet mixture into the dry ingredients, taking care not to overmix.
Transfer everything to your prepared pan or molds and cook — bake, steam, chill, or fry — until set, about 10 mins.
Remove from the heat and let it cool completely; this helps the texture firm up perfectly.
tips: For the cleanest slices, chill the finished dessert thoroughly before cutting.
This keeps well for a couple of days in an airtight container, and the flavor often improves overnight.
